verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַבָּאִ֖ים מִצְרָ֑יְמָה אֵ֣ת יַעֲקֹ֔ב אִ֥ישׁ וּבֵית֖וֹ בָּֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hab·bā·’îm miṣ·rā·yə·māh ’êṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’îš ū·ḇê·ṯōw bā·’ū
verses.literal: These are the names of the sons of Israel who went to Egypt with Jacob each with his family
verses.literalPt: ESTES pois são os nomes dos filhos de Israel, que entraram no Egito com Jacó; cada um entrou com sua casa:

verses.original: רְאוּבֵ֣ן שִׁמְע֔וֹן לֵוִ֖י וִיהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’ū·ḇên šim·‘ō·wn lê·wî wî·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Reuben Simeon Levi and Judah
verses.literalPt: Rúben, Simeão, Levi, e Judá;

verses.original: יִשָּׂשכָ֥ר זְבוּלֻ֖ן וּבְנְיָמִֽן׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·śā·š·ḵār zə·ḇū·lun ū·ḇə·nə·yå̄·min
verses.literal: Issachar Zebulun and Benjamin
verses.literalPt: Issacar, Zebulom, e Benjamim;

verses.original: דָּ֥ן וְנַפְתָּלִ֖י גָּ֥ד וְאָשֵֽׁר׃
verses.transliteration: dān wə·nap̄·tā·lî gāḏ wə·’ā·šêr
verses.literal: Dan and Naphtali Gad and Asher
verses.literalPt: Dã e Naftali, Gade e Aser.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִ֗י כָּל־ נֶ֛פֶשׁ יֹצְאֵ֥י יֶֽרֶךְ־ יַעֲקֹ֖ב שִׁבְעִ֣ים נָ֑פֶשׁ וְיוֹסֵ֖ף הָיָ֥ה בְמִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kāl- ne·p̄eš yō·ṣə·’ê ye·reḵ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ šiḇ·‘îm nā·p̄eš wə·yō·w·sêp̄ hā·yāh ḇə·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: The descendants of Jacob . . . . . . numbered seventy in all . . . including Joseph who was already in Egypt
verses.literalPt: Todas as almas, pois, que procederam dos lombos de Jacó, foram setenta almas; José, porém, estava no Egito.

verses.original: וַיָּ֤מָת יוֹסֵף֙ וְכָל־ אֶחָ֔יו וְכֹ֖ל הַדּ֥וֹר הַהֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ yō·w·sêp̄ wə·ḵāl ’e·ḥāw wə·ḵōl had·dō·wr ha·hū
verses.literal: Now Joseph and all his brothers and all that generation died
verses.literalPt: Faleceu José, e todos os seus irmãos, e toda aquela geração.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל פָּר֧וּ וַֽיִּשְׁרְצ֛וּ וַיִּרְבּ֥וּ וַיַּֽעַצְמ֖וּ בִּמְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֑ד וַתִּמָּלֵ֥א הָאָ֖רֶץ אֹתָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl pā·rū way·yiš·rə·ṣū way·yir·bū way·ya·‘aṣ·mū bim·’ōḏ mə·’ōḏ wat·tim·mā·lê hā·’ā·reṣ ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: but the Israelites . . . were fruitful and increased rapidly they multiplied and became exceedingly . . . numerous so that the land . . . was filled with them
verses.literalPt: E os filhos de Israel frutificaram, aumentaram muito, e multiplicaram-se, e foram fortalecidos grandemente; de maneira que a terra se encheu deles.

verses.original: וַיָּ֥קָם מֶֽלֶךְ־ חָדָ֖שׁ עַל־ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יָדַ֖ע אֶת־ יוֹסֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām me·leḵ- ḥā·ḏāš ‘al- miṣ·rā·yim ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏa‘ ’eṯ- yō·w·sêp̄
verses.literal: Then a new king who did not know Joseph came to power in Egypt
verses.literalPt: E levantou-se um novo rei sobre o Egito, que não conhecera a José;

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֶל־ עַמּ֑וֹ הִנֵּ֗ה עַ֚ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רַ֥ב וְעָצ֖וּם מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el- ‘am·mōw hin·nêh ‘am bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl raḇ wə·‘ā·ṣūm mim·men·nū
verses.literal: Look he said to his people the Israelites . . . . . . have become too numerous and too powerful for us
verses.literalPt: O qual disse ao seu povo: Eis que o povo dos filhos de Israel é muito, e mais poderoso do que nós.

verses.original: הָ֥בָה נִֽתְחַכְּמָ֖ה ל֑וֹ פֶּן־ יִרְבֶּ֗ה וְהָיָ֞ה כִּֽי־ תִקְרֶ֤אנָה מִלְחָמָה֙ וְנוֹסַ֤ף גַּם־ הוּא֙ עַל־ שֹׂ֣נְאֵ֔ינוּ וְנִלְחַם־ בָּ֖נוּ וְעָלָ֥ה מִן־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇāh niṯ·ḥak·kə·māh lōw pen- yir·beh wə·hā·yāh kî- ṯiq·re·nāh mil·ḥā·māh wə·nō·w·sap̄ gam- hū ‘al- śō·nə·’ê·nū wə·nil·ḥam- bā·nū wə·‘ā·lāh min- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Come let us deal shrewdly with them or they will increase even more and if . . . a war breaks out they . . . may join . . . our enemies fight against us and leave . . . the country
verses.literalPt: Eia, usemos de sabedoria para com eles, para que não se multipliquem, e aconteça que, vindo guerra, eles também se ajuntem com os nossos inimigos, e pelejem contra nós, e subam da terra.

verses.original: וַיָּשִׂ֤ימוּ עָלָיו֙ שָׂרֵ֣י מִסִּ֔ים לְמַ֥עַן עַנֹּת֖וֹ בְּסִבְלֹתָ֑ם וַיִּ֜בֶן עָרֵ֤י מִסְכְּנוֹת֙ לְפַרְעֹ֔ה אֶת־ פִּתֹ֖ם וְאֶת־ רַעַמְסֵֽס׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śî·mū ‘ā·lāw śā·rê mis·sîm lə·ma·‘an ‘an·nō·ṯōw bə·siḇ·lō·ṯām way·yi·ḇen ‘ā·rê mis·kə·nō·wṯ lə·p̄ar·‘ōh ’eṯ- pi·ṯōm wə·’eṯ- ra·‘am·sês
verses.literal: So the Egyptians appointed taskmasters . . . over the Israelites to oppress them with forced labor As a result, they built Pithom and Rameses as store cities for Pharaoh
verses.literalPt: E puseram sobre eles maiorais de tributos, para os afligirem com suas cargas. Porque edificaram a Faraó cidades-armazéns, Pitom e Ramessés.

verses.original: וְכַאֲשֶׁר֙ יְעַנּ֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ כֵּ֥ן יִרְבֶּ֖ה וְכֵ֣ן יִפְרֹ֑ץ וַיָּקֻ֕צוּ מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵa·’ă·šer yə·‘an·nū ’ō·ṯōw kên yir·beh wə·ḵên yip̄·rōṣ way·yā·qu·ṣū mip·pə·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But the more they were oppressed - the more they multiplied . . . and flourished so the Egyptians came to dread . . . the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas quanto mais os afligiam, tanto mais se multiplicavam, e tanto mais cresciam; de maneira que se enfadavam por causa dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲבִ֧דוּ מִצְרַ֛יִם אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּפָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·ḇi·ḏū miṣ·ra·yim ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl bə·p̄ā·reḵ
verses.literal: They worked . . . the Israelites . . . ruthlessly
verses.literalPt: E os egípcios faziam servir os filhos de Israel com dureza;

verses.original: וַיְמָרְר֨וּ אֶת־ חַיֵּיהֶ֜ם בַּעֲבֹדָ֣ה קָשָׁ֗ה בְּחֹ֙מֶר֙ וּבִלְבֵנִ֔ים וּבְכָל־ עֲבֹדָ֖ה בַּשָּׂדֶ֑ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־ עֲבֹ֣דָתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ עָבְד֥וּ בָהֶ֖ם בְּפָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·mā·rə·rū ’eṯ- ḥay·yê·hem ba·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh qā·šāh bə·ḥō·mer ū·ḇil·ḇê·nîm ū·ḇə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh baś·śā·ḏeh ’êṯ kāl- ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯām ’ă·šer- ‘ā·ḇə·ḏū ḇā·hem bə·p̄ā·reḵ
verses.literal: and made their lives bitter with hard labor in brick and mortar and with all kinds of work in the fields Every service they imposed was harsh
verses.literalPt: Assim que lhes fizeram amargar a vida com dura servidão, em barro e em tijolos, e com todo o trabalho no campo; com todo o seu serviço, em que os obrigavam com dureza.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם לַֽמְיַלְּדֹ֖ת הָֽעִבְרִיֹּ֑ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר שֵׁ֤ם הָֽאַחַת֙ שִׁפְרָ֔ה וְשֵׁ֥ם הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית פּוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer me·leḵ miṣ·ra·yim lam·yal·lə·ḏōṯ hā·‘iḇ·rî·yōṯ ’ă·šer šêm hā·’a·ḥaṯ šip̄·rāh wə·šêm haš·šê·nîṯ pū·‘āh
verses.literal: Then the king of Egypt said to the Hebrew midwives whose names were Shiphrah . . . and Puah
verses.literalPt: E o rei do Egito falou às parteiras das hebréias (das quais o nome de uma era Sifrá, e o da outra Puá),

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר בְּיַלֶּדְכֶן֙ אֶת־ הָֽעִבְרִיּ֔וֹת וּרְאִיתֶ֖ן עַל־ הָאָבְנָ֑יִם אִם־ בֵּ֥ן הוּא֙ וַהֲמִתֶּ֣ן אֹת֔וֹ וְאִם־ בַּ֥ת הִ֖יא וָחָֽיָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bə·yal·leḏ·ḵen ’eṯ- hā·‘iḇ·rî·yō·wṯ ū·rə·’î·ṯen ‘al- hā·’ā·ḇə·nā·yim ’im- bên hū wa·hă·mit·ten ’ō·ṯōw wə·’im- baṯ hî wā·ḥā·yāh
verses.literal: When you help the Hebrew women give birth observe them on the birthstools If the child is a son kill him but if it is a daughter let her live
verses.literalPt: E disse: Quando ajudardes a dar à luz às hebréias, e as virdes sobre os assentos, se for filho, matai-o; mas se for filha, então viva.

verses.original: וַתִּירֶ֤אןָ הַֽמְיַלְּדֹת֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְלֹ֣א עָשׂ֔וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ן מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם וַתְּחַיֶּ֖יןָ אֶת־ הַיְלָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tî·re·nā ham·yal·lə·ḏōṯ ’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·lō ‘ā·śū ka·’ă·šer dib·ber ’ă·lê·hen me·leḵ miṣ·rā·yim wat·tə·ḥay·ye·nā ’eṯ- hay·lā·ḏîm
verses.literal: The midwives, however feared God and did not do as the king of Egypt had instructed . . . they let the boys live
verses.literalPt: As parteiras, porém, temeram a Deus e não fizeram como o rei do Egito lhes dissera, antes conservavam os meninos com vida.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֤א מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לַֽמְיַלְּדֹ֔ת וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ן מַדּ֥וּעַ עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ן הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֑ה וַתְּחַיֶּ֖יןָ אֶת־ הַיְלָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā me·leḵ- miṣ·ra·yim lam·yal·lə·ḏōṯ way·yō·mer lā·hen mad·dū·a‘ ‘ă·śî·ṯen had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh wat·tə·ḥay·ye·nā ’eṯ- hay·lā·ḏîm
verses.literal: So the king of Egypt summoned the midwives and asked them Why have you done . . . this Why have you let the boys live
verses.literalPt: Então o rei do Egito chamou as parteiras e disse-lhes: Por que fizestes isto, deixando os meninos com vida?

verses.original: וַתֹּאמַ֤רְןָ הַֽמְיַלְּדֹת֙ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֔ה כִּ֣י לֹ֧א כַנָּשִׁ֛ים הַמִּצְרִיֹּ֖ת הָֽעִבְרִיֹּ֑ת כִּֽי־ חָי֣וֹת הֵ֔נָּה בְּטֶ֨רֶם תָּב֧וֹא אֲלֵהֶ֛ן הַמְיַלֶּ֖דֶת וְיָלָֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mar·nā ham·yal·lə·ḏōṯ ’el- par·‘ōh kî lō ḵan·nā·šîm ham·miṣ·rî·yōṯ hā·‘iḇ·rî·yōṯ kî- ḥā·yō·wṯ hên·nāh bə·ṭe·rem tā·ḇō·w ’ă·lê·hen ham·yal·le·ḏeṯ wə·yā·lā·ḏū
verses.literal: The midwives answered . . . Pharaoh The Hebrew women . . . are not like the Egyptian women for they are vigorous and give birth before a midwife arrives . . .
verses.literalPt: E as parteiras disseram a Faraó: É que as mulheres hebréias não são como as egípcias; porque são vivas, e já têm dado à luz antes que a parteira venha a elas.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥יטֶב אֱלֹהִ֖ים לַֽמְיַלְּדֹ֑ת וַיִּ֧רֶב הָעָ֛ם וַיַּֽעַצְמ֖וּ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṭeḇ ’ĕ·lō·hîm lam·yal·lə·ḏōṯ way·yi·reḇ hā·‘ām way·ya·‘aṣ·mū mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: So God was good to the midwives and the people multiplied and became even more numerous
verses.literalPt: Portanto Deus fez bem às parteiras. E o povo se aumentou, e se fortaleceu muito.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י כִּֽי־ יָֽרְא֥וּ הַֽמְיַלְּדֹ֖ת אֶת־ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיַּ֥עַשׂ לָהֶ֖ם בָּתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kî- yā·rə·’ū ham·yal·lə·ḏōṯ ’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·ya·‘aś lā·hem bāt·tîm
verses.literal: And because the midwives feared God He gave them families of their own
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, como as parteiras temeram a Deus, ele estabeleceu-lhes casas.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו פַּרְעֹ֔ה לְכָל־ עַמּ֖וֹ לֵאמֹ֑ר כָּל־ הַבֵּ֣ן הַיִּלּ֗וֹד הַיְאֹ֙רָה֙ תַּשְׁלִיכֻ֔הוּ וְכָל־ הַבַּ֖ת תְּחַיּֽוּן׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw par·‘ōh lə·ḵāl ‘am·mōw lê·mōr kāl- hab·bên hay·yil·lō·wḏ hay·’ō·rāh taš·lî·ḵu·hū wə·ḵāl hab·baṯ tə·ḥay·yūn
verses.literal: Then Pharaoh commanded all his people . . . Every son born to the Hebrews you must throw into the Nile but every daughter you may allow to live
verses.literalPt: Então ordenou Faraó a todo o seu povo, dizendo: A todos os filhos que nascerem lançareis no rio, mas a todas as filhas guardareis com vida.
